name: It Comes Back On Its Own
hint: Two takes. The pit runs from x=12 to x=27 — fifteen units, so no jump crosses it and the ferry is the only way over. The exit at x=36.5 sits behind door d1 (x=31, six units tall with the bulkhead above it running to the top of the world) and d1's only power is plate p1 at x=4..6.2, back on the LEFT bank: you cannot hold the door and be the passenger. The ferry m1 takes no signal at all. It ping-pongs between x=22.5 (right) and x=12.7 (left) at 3.2 u/s with a 0.4s dwell at each end — a 6.9-second round trip — and it starts the take parked at the RIGHT end, so its first move is toward you. TAKE 1: walk right from spawn onto p1 and stand there; end the take on the plate, and use the wait to count the ferry. TAKE 2: your Echo steps onto p1 at about t=0.3s and holds it for good, so d1 is fully open by about t=0.7s. Run right to x=11.9, where the deck's left face stops you — that is 9.9 units, about 1.3s — and wait. The ferry reaches the left end at t=3.06s and dwells until t=3.46s; hop the 0.7 units up onto the deck (deck top y=19.3, banks are y=20) during that dwell. It departs at t=3.46s and reaches the right end at t=6.52s, where its right edge lands exactly on the bank edge at x=27, so walk straight off it and drop 0.7 onto solid ground. Run the 4 units right through the open doorway at x=31 and on into the exit at x=36.5, about t=7.8s. Do NOT chase the ferry once it has left: from x=11.9 the longest running jump puts you near x=18.2 while the deck's left edge is already past x=19.8, and you drop into the pit. Miss the window and simply wait — it comes back every 6.9 seconds, forever.

dialogue.text: No plate on it. No switch. It just goes, and goes back.

dialogue.speaker: ECHO-0
dialogue.text: Then it owes you nothing. Learn its count and stand where it will be.
Seven seconds. I counted them while I was busy being someone's door.
